newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Sky Vision sees subscribers increasing.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Sky Vision sees subscribers increasing.

text.p: Sky Vision Corp, the Philippine's largest cable television company, said on Saturday it expected an increase in its subscriber base to 250,000 by year-end.
"We are expanding our reach in preparation for the initial public offering by yearend," said Manuel Lopez Jr, Sky Vision director on Saturday.
At present, Lopez said the cable firm has 200,000 subscribers with a 60 percent market share nationwide.
Sky Vision earlier announced plans to undertake an IPO.
Sky Vision was a unit of Benpres Holdings Corp before its stockholders approved the transfer of shares to unlisted Lopez Inc.
